source.attribution: Observed laboratory-confirmed influenza hospital admissions reported to CDC/NHSN, distributed by the CDC FluSight Forecast Hub. No source model forecasts are used. No CDC endorsement is implied.

protocol.target: Weekly reported laboratory-confirmed influenza hospital admissions
protocol.selection: Lowest pooled validation MAE; ties follow model order
protocol.publication_gate: Validation winner must strictly beat both last_value and seasonal_naive on pooled holdout MAE
protocol.evaluation_role: Retrospective rolling-origin evaluation using a pinned revised dataset; not real-time vintage validation

publication.reason: Validation winner did not strictly beat both simple baselines on pooled holdout MAE.

limitations: Retrospective evaluation uses a pinned revised dataset, not historical release vintages.
Reporting requirements, coverage, and data revisions can change counts.
Origins assume observations are available at week end; publication delays are not replayed.
Horizon/weekly errors overlap and are correlated; this is one held-out season.
These are reported influenza admissions, not unique patients or all-cause facility demand.
Point forecasts have no estimated uncertainty intervals and are not an operational planning service.
